Bose SoundLink Max Portable Speaker – Powerful Stereo Sound with 20 Hours Battery

Experience premium audio performance with the Bose SoundLink Max Portable Speaker, engineered for deep bass, crystal-clear highs, and immersive stereo sound. Designed for music lovers who demand powerful output and durability, this Bluetooth portable speaker delivers room-filling performance whether you’re indoors, outdoors, or on the move. With advanced wireless connectivity and rugged construction, it stands out as a top choice for anyone searching for a high-quality portable Bluetooth speaker.

Built with full range speakers and optimized stereo sound, the Bose SoundLink Max Portable Speaker ensures balanced audio across every genre. Whether you are hosting a party, traveling, or relaxing at home, the stereo and Simple Sync sound options provide seamless pairing with compatible Bose speakers for an enhanced listening experience. The speaker does not include a microphone, focusing purely on delivering uninterrupted, high-fidelity sound performance.

Powerful Stereo Sound with Advanced Bluetooth 5.4

Featuring Bluetooth version 5.4, this wireless speaker offers faster pairing, improved connectivity stability, and efficient power consumption. The USB-C (In/Out) port ensures quick charging and convenient device compatibility. With no audio cable included, the speaker is optimized for wireless streaming, providing a clutter-free and modern setup.

Up to 20 Hours Battery Life

Enjoy up to 20 hours of battery life on a single charge, making it ideal for long trips, outdoor gatherings, and extended listening sessions. The battery charge time is approximately 5 hours, allowing you to quickly power up and get back to your music. This long-lasting portable speaker ensures consistent performance throughout the day.

IP67 Water and Dust Resistance

With an IP67 rating, the Bose SoundLink Max Portable Speaker is both water resistant and dust resistant. Whether you’re at the beach, by the pool, or hiking on dusty trails, this waterproof Bluetooth speaker is built to handle tough environments without compromising sound quality.

Premium Build and Durable Materials

Crafted from aluminum, fabric, nylon, plastic, silicone, and steel, the speaker offers a robust yet stylish design. The materials ensure durability while maintaining a premium look and feel. Measuring 31.8 x 15.8 x 22.4 cm and weighing 6.5 lb, it provides a substantial presence with portability in mind.

Key Features

  • Sound Options: Stereo, Simple Sync, Full Range Speakers
  • Microphones: No microphone
  • Wireless Connectivity: Bluetooth 5.4, USB-C (In/Out)
  • Water / Dust Resistance: IP67 rated
  • Battery Life: Up to 20 hours
  • Battery Charge Time: Approximately 5 hours
  • Dimensions: 31.8 x 15.8 x 22.4 cm
  • Weight: 6.5 lb
  • Materials: Aluminum, Fabric, Nylon, Plastic, Silicone, Steel
  • Audio Cable Included: No

Why Choose?

If you are searching for the best portable Bluetooth speaker with long battery life and waterproof design, the offers a perfect balance of performance, durability, and premium design. Its stereo sound output and advanced Bluetooth 5.4 connectivity make it suitable for home entertainment, outdoor adventures, and travel use.

The IP67 rating ensures reliability in challenging environments, while the 20-hour battery life keeps your music playing without interruptions. With USB-C charging and modern wireless features, this speaker delivers convenience and next-level audio clarity.
